story.iWant: I want to bootstrap a demo company, users, and chart of accounts for tests
story.soThat: so that everyone can develop, demo, and QA flows instantly
story.tasks: - Backend: Create Seed Data Script (AC: #1, #2, #3) - Create Flyway migration V2__seed_demo_data.sql - Insert demo company, users (admin, accountant, chief_accountant, cfo) with Bcrypt passwords - Insert minimal TT200 Chart of Accounts subset - Backend: Mark Demo Company Name with "[DEMO]" (AC: #4) - Ensure name includes suffix "[DEMO]" - Verify logs/summary mark DEMO company - Backend: Create Rollback Mechanism (AC: #5) - Create SQL to DELETE/TRUNCATE seeded demo data (demo tenant only) - Documentation: Update README (AC: #5) - Add Development section; document migrate and rollback commands - Testing: Verify Seed Data (AC: #1, #2, #3, #4, #5, #6) - Confirm migration created company, users, COA subset - Verify 4 role users exist; authenticate at least admin - Validate COA subset TT200-compliant with postable leaf accounts - Confirm "[DEMO]" suffix visible in UI/logs - Execute rollback; ensure only demo data removed - Walk happy-path flows for Epic 1 using demo data

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. A CLI command or Flyway migration script (V2__...) populates a demo company with sample users and a minimal chart of accounts. 2. Demo data includes one user for each core role: admin, accountant, chief_accountant, cfo. 3. The seeded Chart of Accounts is a valid, minimal subset of TT200, including postable leaf accounts for common transactions. 4. The demo company is clearly marked with a "[DEMO]" suffix in its name to distinguish it in the UI and logs. 5. A corresponding rollback script (R__... or manual instructions) is provided to truncate demo data for repeatable testing. 6. The seed data is sufficient to support "happy path" testing for all completed stories in Epic 1 (Login, Company Settings, User Management).

story-context.constraints: - Use Flyway versioned migrations for seed and rollback - Keep seeding idempotent; safe to run multiple times - Hash demo user passwords using production algorithm (BCrypt) - Enforce company scoping; demo data isolated by company_id - Use TT200-compliant leaf accounts; no non-postable leaves

tests.standards: Backend: JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Starter Test with Testcontainers (PostgreSQL). Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library + jsdom. Follow architecture testing locations and patterns; use Given/When/Then style for AC mapping.
tests.ideas: - AC1: Run Flyway migrate; assert demo company/users/COA subset present (SQL checks) - AC2: Verify roles admin/accountant/chief_accountant/cfo exist; login smoke test (admin) - AC3: Validate TT200 subset contains postable leaf accounts; no non-postable leaves used - AC4: Fetch company; assert name ends with "[DEMO]"; UI render shows suffix - AC5: Run rollback; verify only demo tenant data removed; other tenants intact - AC6: Execute happy-path flows for Epic 1 using demo data (login, settings, user mgmt)
